title: Photogression — A Field Journal for Perception
bodyText: SUNDAY, SEPTEMBER 20 ⌖ 0 OBSERVED Photo gression A field journal for perception. Collect not places, but ways of seeing. CURRENT LENS CHANGE → Boundaries find where two conditions meet.
